title: Measures at Educational Institutions to Detect, Minimise and Combat Bullying Based on Gender Expression
what_it_is: Measures at Educational Institutions to Detect, Minimise and Combat Bullying Based on Gender Expression

sections.label: Anti-bullying measures in schools
sections.summary: Measures detect and address bullying, including based on sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, with training and support in schools and PSEIs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) what measures are in place to detect, minimise and combat bullying based on sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, at educational institutions; (b) whether these measures differ by the level of the educational institution, from secondary schools through post-secondary institutions; and (c) whether teachers, staff and administrators receive training to handle such incidents sensitively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We have zero tolerance for bullying in any form, and every student has a right to feel safe and secure in all our schools and post-secondary educational institutions (PSEIs).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: When such cases are reported, they are promptly investigated and followed up with counselling support for victims and appropriate disciplinary action against the perpetrators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Therefore, schools also work closely with parents to help the perpetrators take responsibility for their actions and restore relationships with those they have hurt.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We have professional counsellors and also trained teachers, academic mentors and peer helpers, trained to look out for students in distress and be proactive in attending to and also addressing all hurtful behaviour, including acts directed against students due to their sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students are also taught to speak up against and report bullying to school authorities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These education efforts are continued in the PSEIs which create and raise anti-bullying awareness with modules, such as teaching lifeskills, lunchtime talks and also student outreach initiatives.

sections.label: Anti-bullying guidelines and sensitivity training
sections.summary: The Minister states no bullying is tolerated in schools and PSEIs, and bullying is a school offence with serious consequences.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Second, are there plans to develop anti-bullying guidelines or programmes, including sensitivity training for staff and teachers, that specifically address this type of sexual orientation or gender role identity kind of bullying?

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that no bullying of any form is tolerated at any time in our schools and PSEIs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Bullying is a school offence and it comes with very serious consequences for the perpetrators.

sections.label: Counsellors support parents and students
sections.summary: Counsellors share suggestions to help parents support their children, and MOE, schools and PSEIs have measures for a safe learning environment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The counsellors, where relevant, will also share suggestions to help the parents to talk to and also better support their children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, I want to assure the Member that MOE, our schools and PSEIs are committed to very high standards of discipline and we have put in place systems and a series of measures to create a safe, secure and conducive learning environment for our students.

sections.label: MOE resources on character and discipline
sections.summary: MOE provides schools and teachers resources on instilling good character and discipline, and will continue improving systems for a safe learning environment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: MOE also provides schools and teachers with resources and information on how to instil good character and discipline.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, I want to assure the Member that MOE will continue to look at how we can improve our systems and measures to make sure that we provide a safe, secure and conducive learning environment for all our students.
